Description
This is a simple list of every enemy in the game. It does not list locations or stats, only the name and corresponding number of each enemy. It is recommended that you copy and paste this list into a separate doc and subtract entries as you discover them during your playthrough. Alternatively, you can access the attached Google Docs link and save a copy.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1J2WBXMqwPoa6zKGuKHvrRYeoBSFvWbfS1B7NDTsO7ms/edit?usp=sharing

This is best used as a tool for keeping track of discovered monsters during a playthrough! Good luck on 100% completion!

sections.html:
Tule
Overworld

Note: There are currently no random encounters in the sea.

Sail north past the mountains to trigger a cutscene.
Answer with 'No' to control the ship yourself, then head northwest to find a town.


Go inside.

Tule

Head north to watch the pirates get a drink from the Pub.
Now once you regain control, go east and through the small alley by the Inn to find a barrel.
Search the barrel for 150 Gil. {1/46}


Backtrack to the entrance and go north past the Pub to find some boxes and barrels.
Search the top left box for a Tent. {2/46}


Now search the barrel at the opposite side to find a Potion. {3/46}


Go across the bridge to find Zok's house, but don't head inside yet. Instead, go west around the house to find a secret passage.
Inspect the bush at the top of the house for a Phoenix Down. {4/46}


Now do the same thing but at the east side this time. Search the box at the very top for Leather Shoes. {5/46}


Make your way back to the entrance of the town and head west to find a building.
Go inside.

Greenhorn's Club

Speak to the receptionist and answer with 'Yes'.
Search the pot for a Potion, the barrel for a Phoenix Down, and the box for a Tent. {8/46}


Also, open both chests for an Ether and 100 Gil. [4/225]
Note: Left chest is only reachable through the secret passage shown in the screenshot.

Now go upstairs and open the lone chest on the west side for a Monsters-in-a-box encounter. Don't worry. It's just a Goblin.


After defeating that monstrosity, you will be rewarded with Leather Shoes for such a feat. [5/225]
Don't forget to upgrade your party's equipment.
That concludes all collectibles for this location. However, we're still missing something important in this town so don't leave just yet. Leave the building though.

Tule

Enter the Pub

Tule - Pub

Sit at the stool by the stage to make the dancers dance for you. This will make them get out of the path to the piano (which is our objective).
Go up the stage and play the piano. [Piano Maestro: 1/8]


Note: This step is required for the Piano Maestro achievement.
Optional: Head upstairs and sneak into Faris bedroom to trigger a funny cutscene.

Exit the Pub.

Tule

Now go shopping spree if you desire. Just remember that you can't use magic yet.

Overworld

Hop on Hiryu and fly a little northeast (you must go around the mountains, of course) to find our next destination.
Refer to the screenshot below for the exact location.


This location is Walse and it's divided into two areas. The left one is the castle and the right is the town. Head into the town first.

Swim west and enter the westernmost house.

Inspect the white pot to find Silver Specs. {22/46}


That's the only collectible here. Feel free to visit the shops to purchase anything you want.

This is a tough battle.
If you have the blue magic 'Flash', this is a good time to make use of it. Ice Commanders' are not resistant against Darkness status and doing that can pretty much null all their devastating physical attacks.
Make your Black Mage (if you have one) spam fire-based spells on Shiva until taking her down. Yes, start with her as she can become extremely annoying with her Blizzara attacks.
As with the White Mage, heal your party on all turns, one by one if possible as healing all at once can be counterproductive if the enemies are focusing on just one of your characters.
The rest of the party can attack with anything you have. Just try to stick to the correct order: Shiva → Ice Commanders.

After winning this difficult fight, you will be rewarded with the powerful summoned monster Shiva!
If you're having issues winning this battle at this time, you can wait until our next visit here to give it another go.

Anyway, now that we're done here, backtrack to the main hall of the castle (walk south of the orb for a shortcut outside the waterfall) and then head into the throne room.

Whatever you do, DON'T free the Lone Wolf as that will get future treasure chests stolen, an action that may void the 'open all treasure chests' achievement...

Watch the scenes to set your next objective!
Exit to the overworld.

Note: We're purposely skipping a section of this dungeon since it's way too hard for this point of the game. We will come back later when we are stronger!

This is a tough battle.
If you have the blue magic 'Flash', this is a good time to make use of it. Ice Commanders' are not resistant against Darkness status and doing that can pretty much null all their devastating physical attacks.
Make your Black Mage (if you have one) spam fire-based spells on Shiva until taking her down. Yes, start with her as she can become extremely annoying with her Blizzara attacks.
As with the White Mage, heal your party on all turns, one by one if possible as healing all at once can be counterproductive if the enemies are focusing on just one of your characters.
The rest of the party can attack with anything you have. Just try to stick to the correct order: Shiva → Ice Commanders.
After winning this difficult fight, you will be rewarded with the powerful summoned monster Shiva!
If you're having issues winning this battle at this time, you can wait until our next visit here to give it another go.
Anyway, now that we're done here, backtrack to the main hall of the castle (walk south of the orb for a shortcut outside the waterfall) and then head into the throne room.
Whatever you do, DON'T free the Lone Wolf as that will get future treasure chests stolen, an action that may void the 'open all treasure chests' achievement...
Watch the scenes to set your next objective!
Exit to the overworld.
Note: We're purposely skipping a section of this dungeon since it's way too hard for this point of the game. We will come back later when we are stronger!

Go around the structure and up another set of stairs.

Tower of Walse - 5F

Open the chest for a Silk Robe. [27/225]


Drop down the hole to return to 4F.

Tower of Walse - 4F

Exit the water and take the stairs leading up.

Tower of Walse - 5F

There's a consecrated circle here. Feel free to save/rest.

Continue your way to the top through the linear floors up to 8F.

Jump down back to the previous floor.

Back at 8F, climb up the northeastern vine this time.

Tower of Walse - 9F

Open the chest here for an Ether. [30/225]


And with that, we're done with the collectibles for this dungeon. 4/4 chests.
Take the stairs leading up.

Crystal Room

Before moving, heal up and quick-save.
Then, once prepared, go north to trigger a cutscene and the next boss fight.

Easiest way to win: Keep using the blue magic 'Pond's Chorus' to turn Garula into a toad. The boss will cast toad on itself to recover from status, but won't do anything else and that turn will be considered wasted. Continue casting Pond's Chorus to waste all boss turns while the rest of the party focuses on attacking with anything you have.
In older versions, you could cast Silence on the boss to make it stop using Toad, but that doesn't seem to work here.

After the fight, watch the short scene and collect the crystal shards from the floor.

Jobs unlocked:

  • Red Mage
  • Berserker
  • Mystic Knight
  • Time Mage

The last crystal shard is sadly unreachable.
The tower will start shaking, so leave through the back opening before it crumbles.

Watch the scenes...

From outside the meteorite, go west and follow the woods north to reach a split.
At the split, head southwest and follow the linear path to reach a castle and a town. This is Karnak.


Enter the town.

Karnak

From the entrance, head northwest and enter the Pub.

Karnak - Pub

Play the piano to get progress towards the related achievement. [Piano Maestro: 3/8]


Exit the Pub.

Enter the Weapons/Armor shop and speak to any of the attendants. You'll get arrested, wtf?

Karnak Castle - B4

You'll wake up in a cell.
Approach the jail door to trigger a cutscene. BOOM!

Speak to the old man to meet Cid! Hell yeah! and watch some more scenes.

Once regaining control, go north through the open jail door and up the stairs.

Karnak Castle - B3

Continue north and go up another set of stairs.

Karnak Castle - B2

Walk around the middle structure and through the door.

Karnak Castle - B1

Head north and up the stairs.

Karnak Castle - 1F

We're finally in the main hall. Exit the castle through the southern door.
Note: Don't bother by trying to loot anything, most of the castle is blocked by fire at the moment. We will return later anyways.

Karnak Castle

While exiting the castle, you'll watch a short scene with the wolf we decided not to free in Walse. I'm pretty sure we'll meet again with that peculiar character in the near future.
As for now, exit to the overworld.

All shops are now open and free to explore, so it's a good time to upgrade your spells and equipment!
